title: Hegseth Makes Surprise Visit to Israel as Netanyahu Tells Trump 'We Have a Job to Finish' on Iran (Unverified)
detail: A news aggregator headline reports that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made a surprise visit to Israel, while Israeli PM Netanyahu told President Trump 'we have a job to finish' on Iran. The item is a headline only; details of the visit and remarks have not been independently verified.
